about: Dock talk: what haulers, loaders and miners say in cantinas when nobody is talking about the captain. Story rumours are told first; this fills the rest.

gossip.night_shift.title: Gossip: night shift
gossip.night_shift.text: The night shift at the fuel depot got a pay rise. The day shift found out from the night shift's new boots.

gossip.coffee.title: Gossip: coffee
gossip.coffee.text: Someone put real coffee in the dock canteen machine. Nobody knows who. The union wants it written into the contract.

gossip.crane.title: Gossip: crane
gossip.crane.text: Crane four has been 'out for maintenance' since spring. The maintenance crew says crane four knows what it did.

gossip.manifest.title: Gossip: manifest
gossip.manifest.text: A hauler swears his manifest said forty crates of agri. He opened them at the dock. Forty crates of slightly different agri.

gossip.queue.title: Gossip: queue
gossip.queue.text: Customs queue at the inner lock is three hours today. The man in front of you has been in it since yesterday and seems happy.

gossip.soup.title: Gossip: soup
gossip.soup.text: The soup today is called 'Tuesday'. It is Thursday. Nobody orders it, and every bowl goes.

gossip.hull_paint.title: Gossip: hull paint
gossip.hull_paint.text: Hull paint went up again. A captain at the bar says his ship is now mostly primer and good intentions.

gossip.cards.title: Gossip: cards
gossip.cards.text: Two loaders are playing cards with a deck that has three queens of hearts. Neither of them mentions it.

gossip.pension.title: Gossip: pension
gossip.pension.text: Old Marek retired after forty years of hauling. He bought a ship to live on. He says the commute is better.

gossip.forklift.title: Gossip: forklift
gossip.forklift.text: A forklift drove itself into the harbour pool last night. Engineering says software. The forklift says nothing.

gossip.rations.title: Gossip: rations
gossip.rations.text: Ration bars have a new flavour. The packet says 'savoury'. The dockers have voted on 'brown'.

gossip.dock_cat.title: Gossip: dock cat
gossip.dock_cat.text: The dock cat has been promoted to safety officer. It has done better inspections than the last one.

gossip.weather.title: Gossip: weather
gossip.weather.text: Station weather says rain at six. It always says rain at six. The sprinklers in the arcade agree.

gossip.insurance.title: Gossip: insurance
gossip.insurance.text: Insurance rates for the outer lanes went up after a pilot claimed a comet as a personal enemy.

gossip.strike_rumour.title: Gossip: strike rumour
gossip.strike_rumour.text: Somebody says the loaders are going on strike. Somebody else says the loaders are robots. A third says that is the point.

gossip.long_haul.title: Gossip: long haul
gossip.long_haul.text: A long-haul crew came in after nine months out. Two of them are married now. To each other, they think.

gossip.parts.title: Gossip: parts
gossip.parts.text: The spare-parts man has a coupling that fits your ship. He also has one that fits every ship, and it costs more.

gossip.tip.title: Gossip: tip
gossip.tip.text: A pilot leaves a tip in Marks. The barman bites it, shrugs, and pockets it anyway.

gossip.karaoke.title: Gossip: karaoke
gossip.karaoke.text: Karaoke night was cancelled after the third rendition of the same mining song. The miners call it a protest.

gossip.delivery.title: Gossip: delivery
gossip.delivery.text: A courier has been looking for 'the captain with the red hatch' all week. Half the ships at the dock have red hatches now.

gossip.pilot_exam.title: Gossip: pilot exam
gossip.pilot_exam.text: The pilot exam has a new question about what to do if your cargo starts talking. The answer is still 'file a form'.

gossip.garden.title: Gossip: garden
gossip.garden.text: Someone grows tomatoes in the airlock between shifts. Security has decided not to know about it.

gossip.canteen_robot.title: Gossip: canteen robot
gossip.canteen_robot.text: The canteen robot has started saying 'have a nice day' in a tone that suggests it means something else.

gossip.sleeper_berths.title: Gossip: sleeper berths
gossip.sleeper_berths.text: Sleeper berths are full again. A miner rented a cupboard and now sublets half of it.

gossip.fines.title: Gossip: fines
gossip.fines.text: Docking fines went up by ten per cent. The sign announcing it cost more than the fines will bring in.

gossip.old_ship.title: Gossip: old ship
gossip.old_ship.text: An old hauler limps in with three engines out of four. The captain says the fourth is the reliable one.

gossip.barter.title: Gossip: barter
gossip.barter.text: Two crews trade a crate of salt for a crate of fuel and both go away sure they won.

gossip.broken_lift.title: Gossip: broken lift
gossip.broken_lift.text: The lift to the upper deck is broken, so the upper deck has become very exclusive.

gossip.new_kid.title: Gossip: new kid
gossip.new_kid.text: A new pilot asks where the bathroom is and gets four sets of directions, all wrong, all with love.

gossip.legion_ad.title: Gossip: legion ad
gossip.legion_ad.text: A legion recruiting poster promises adventure, travel and a pension. Someone has written 'pick two' underneath.

gossip.ore_dust.title: Gossip: ore dust
gossip.ore_dust.text: Ore dust in everything again. The barman says the beer has extra minerals and charges for it.

gossip.drill_bits.title: Gossip: drill bits
gossip.drill_bits.text: Drill bits are scarce this month. A mining crew is trying to sharpen the old ones with a song. It is not working.

gossip.cave_in.title: Gossip: cave in
gossip.cave_in.text: A gallery collapsed on level nine. Nobody hurt. The foreman says the rock got tired of waiting.

gossip.shift_bell.title: Gossip: shift bell
gossip.shift_bell.text: The shift bell rang twice by mistake and half the mine went home. Management is trying to decide whose fault the bell is.

gossip.outpost_mail.title: Gossip: outpost mail
gossip.outpost_mail.text: The mail drone came in a week late, carrying birthday cards for last month and a tax notice for next year.

gossip.outpost_lights.title: Gossip: outpost lights
gossip.outpost_lights.text: Outpost power is rationed. The bar runs on candles shaped like the outpost commander.

gossip.outpost_shift.title: Gossip: outpost shift
gossip.outpost_shift.text: The radar watch says it saw something big go past at two in the morning. It did not stop, so it did not need a form.

gossip.lonely.title: Gossip: lonely
gossip.lonely.text: A man at the end of the bar has been posted here for six years. He asks you what the weather is like on planets.

gossip.research_grant.title: Gossip: research grant
gossip.research_grant.text: A research team got their grant renewed. They are celebrating with a cake shaped like a confidence interval.

gossip.lab_fridge.title: Gossip: lab fridge
gossip.lab_fridge.text: Someone ate a sample from the lab fridge. The researchers are less worried about the sample than about the someone.

gossip.thesis.title: Gossip: thesis
gossip.thesis.text: A doctoral student has been rewriting chapter three since the colony was founded.

gossip.planet_market.title: Gossip: planet market
gossip.planet_market.text: Market day: a fruit seller shouts prices at the haulers, and the haulers shout back lower ones.

gossip.planet_rain.title: Gossip: planet rain
gossip.planet_rain.text: It rained real rain on the landing field. Half the dockers went out to stand in it.

gossip.planet_tourists.title: Gossip: planet tourists
gossip.planet_tourists.text: Tourists from the inner systems are taking pictures of the dock workers. The dock workers are charging.

gossip.saves.title: Gossip: saves
gossip.saves.text: A drunk hauler swears the whole station saves itself every few turns. 'That's why nobody here dies properly,' he says, and orders another.

gossip.same_talk.title: Gossip: same talk
gossip.same_talk.text: A man at the bar says he keeps hearing the same handful of conversations. He has heard this one twice.

gossip.window.title: Gossip: window
gossip.window.text: Convoy pilots never look out of the window during a jump. Nobody remembers why. Nobody has looked.

gossip.space_big.title: Gossip: space big
gossip.space_big.text: Somebody at the next table is explaining that space is very big. Everyone else at the table is a hauler, and stopped listening years ago.

gossip.make_a_man.title: Gossip: make a man
gossip.make_a_man.text: A recruiting sergeant promises the legion will make a man of you. A neurodroid at the next table asks what it would make of him. The sergeant is still thinking.

gossip.dave.title: Gossip: dave
gossip.dave.text: Somebody's ship computer has started calling everyone on board Dave. Nobody on the crew is called Dave. They are thinking of hiring one, to be safe.

gossip.undo.title: Gossip: undo
gossip.undo.text: A trainee asks why every ship has a self-destruct switch and no undo. The instructor says it is a design philosophy.

gossip.ration.title: Gossip: ration
gossip.ration.text: The legion mess has a sign: 'Today's ration: the same as yesterday's. Tomorrow's: see today.'
